slides.title: All About Me and My Family
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 3 English, Unit 1: All About Me and My Family. In this unit you will learn how to talk about yourself and your family, and about the values that hold a family and a school together: respect, honour, and duty. You will learn how to behave well in public and in private, and how to talk about health and safety. By the end you will introduce your family, ask Wh- questions, give clear instructions, and share what matters to you, just as Amal does in this unit's story. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Talk about the people in your family and what you do together.
Use new words like respect, honour, duty, health, and safety.
Say what is happening now, using the present continuous (“I am helping.”).
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to talk about the people in your family and what you do together. You will also use new words like respect, honour, duty, health, and safety. You will also say what is happening now, using the present continuous (“I am helping.”) Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Words to learn
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: family, parent, friend, student, junior, senior. Listen to each word, look at what it means, and try to use it when you talk and write.

slides.title: Read and think
bullets: Point to the words that show it
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes My Family and Good Behaviour at School. Read slowly, look at the pictures, and find the big idea in each text. When you answer a question, point to the words that show it.

slides.title: Present Continuous (what is happening now)

Try it in your own sentences
slides.narration: The first language focus is Present Continuous (what is happening now). We use the present continuous to talk about actions that are happening right now. It helps us say exactly what people are doing at this moment, like “The student is showing respect.” Look at the examples, then try the pattern in your own sentences.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Say it, write it, make it better
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1 — Introduce Your Family. Say your ideas clearly and listen to your partner. In writing, you will draw, trace, copy or write, then check your work with a grown-up or the AI tutor.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the words, then the reading and the questions, then the grammar, speaking and writing. Ask the AI tutor for help any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
